WITH avg_diff AS (
    SELECT AVG(Enrollment (K-12)) - AVG(Enrollment (Ages 5-17)) AS avg_diff
    FROM frpm
    WHERE Charter Funding Type = 'Locally funded'
)
SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE (f.Enrollment (K-12) - f.Enrollment (Ages 5-17)) > (SELECT avg_diff FROM avg_diff)
AND s.FundingType = 'Locally funded';

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode AND s.NCESSchool = f.School_Code
WHERE f.Charter_Funding_Type = 'Locally funded'
AND ABS(f.Enrollment_K_12 - f.Enrollment_Ages_5_17) > (
    SELECT AVG(ABS(f2.Enrollment_K_12 - f2.Enrollment_Ages_5_17))
    FROM frpm f2
    JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode AND f2.School_Code = s2.NCESSchool
    WHERE f2.Charter_Funding_Type = 'Locally funded'
);

WITH AvgDiff AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(Enrollment (K-12)) - AVG(Enrollment (Ages 5-17)) AS avg_diff
    FROM 
        frpm
    WHERE 
        Charter Funding Type = 'Locally funded'
)
SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.DOCType
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode AND s.NCESSchool = f.School Code
WHERE 
    (f.Enrollment (K-12) - f.Enrollment (Ages 5-17)) > (SELECT avg_diff FROM AvgDiff)
    AND s.FundingType = 'Locally funded';

WITH AvgDiff AS (
    SELECT AVG(Enrollment (K-12)) - AVG(Enrollment (Ages 5-17)) AS avg_diff
    FROM frpm
    WHERE Charter Funding Type = 'Locally funded'
)
SELECT s.School, s.DOCType, f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] - f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)] AS diff
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded' AND diff > (SELECT avg_diff FROM AvgDiff);

WITH AverageDifference AS (
    SELECT AVG(Enrollment (Ages 5-17) - Enrollment (K-12)) AS avg_diff
    FROM frpm
    WHERE Charter Funding Type = 'Locally funded'
),
FilteredSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        s.School,
        s.DOCType,
        f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)],
        f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)],
        f.[Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)],
        f.[Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)]
    FROM 
        frpm f
    JOIN 
        schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE 
        f.[Charter Funding Type] = 'Locally funded'
)
SELECT 
    fs.School,
    fs.DOCType,
    fs.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)],
    fs.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)],
    fs.[Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)],
    fs.[Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)]
FROM 
    FilteredSchools fs
WHERE 
    ABS(fs.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] - fs.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)]) > (SELECT avg_diff FROM AverageDifference);

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.DOCType,
    ABS(s.[Enrollment (K-12)] - s.[Enrollment (Ages 5-17)]) AS EnrollmentDifference
FROM 
    schools s
WHERE 
    s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
HAVING 
    ABS(s.[Enrollment (K-12)] - s.[Enrollment (Ages 5-17)]) > (
        SELECT 
            AVG(ABS(f.[Enrollment (K-12)] - f.[Enrollment (Ages 5-17)]))
        FROM 
            frpm f
        WHERE 
            f.[Charter Funding Type] = 'Locally funded'
    );

    s.School,

FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    f.[Charter Funding Type] = 'Locally funded'
HAVING 
    ABS(f.[Enrollment (K-12)] - f.[Enrollment (Ages 5-17)]) > (
        SELECT 
            AVG(ABS(f2.[Enrollment (K-12)] - f2.[Enrollment (Ages 5-17)]))
        FROM 
            frpm f2
        JOIN 
            schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode

    )
ORDER BY 
    EnrollmentDifference DESC;

SELECT 
    s.SchoolName,
    s.DOCType
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
    AND ABS(f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
        SELECT AVG(ABS(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`))
        FROM frpm f2
        JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.DOCType,
    AVG(f.Enrollment (Ages 5-17)) - AVG(f.Enrollment (K-12)) AS diff
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    f.Charter Funding Type = 'Locally funded'
GROUP BY 
    s.School, s.DOCType
HAVING 
    diff > (SELECT AVG(diff) FROM 
            (SELECT 
                 AVG(f2.Enrollment (Ages 5-17)) - AVG(f2.Enrollment (K-12)) AS diff
             FROM 
                 frpm f2
             JOIN 
                 schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
             WHERE 
                 f2.Charter Funding Type = 'Locally funded'
             GROUP BY 
                 s2.School, s2.DOCType));

SELECT
